_note: Cold open of Danske Drabssager 'Det Brændende Lig', episode time 01:34.50-01:59.35. Timings are episode seconds. Prompts are for the machine and stay in English.

A.name: Dokumentar-rekonstruktion (fotografisk)
A.look: Documentary true-crime re-enactment photographed on 35mm motion-picture film, Kodak Vision3 500T, available light only. Denmark, late September 1999, dusk, heavy rain. Beech forest near Koege: smooth grey trunks, wet copper-brown leaf litter, mist between the trees. Muted cold palette; the only warm light is the fire. Natural film grain, slight halation, shallow depth of field, imperfect handheld framing, wide 2.39:1 composition with the action in the middle band of the frame. No text, no logos. No face is ever visible.
A.cast: Two Danish children about 9 and 7 years old in 1999 rain gear: the older in a yellow PU rain jacket with the hood up, navy rain trousers and green rubber boots; the younger in a navy rain jacket with the hood up and red rubber boots. Always seen from behind or as silhouettes.
A.motion: Realistic, slow documentary camera movement, handheld. Rain keeps falling. Flames flicker naturally. People move slowly and naturally.
A.negative: face, visible face, eyes, text, letters, watermark, logo, cartoon, anime, 3d render, cgi, plastic skin, oversaturated, extra limbs, deformed hands, modern clothing, smartphone, sunny, dry ground

B.name: Tegnet (kul og blæk)
B.look: Hand-drawn graphic-novel illustration in charcoal and ink wash on textured paper. Limited palette: black, cold blue-grey and a single warm orange for the fire. Loose expressive lines, heavy shadows, cinematic wide 2.39:1 composition with the action in the middle band. Not photographic. No text. No face is ever visible.
B.cast: Two children about 9 and 7 in rain jackets with the hoods up, the older in yellow, the younger in dark blue with red boots. Always seen from behind or as silhouettes.
B.motion: Limited, hand-animated feel: flames, rain and smoke move; figures move minimally; the paper texture and line work stay stable. No morphing.
B.negative: photograph, photorealistic, 3d render, cgi, face, eyes, text, watermark, logo, glossy, smooth gradients

shots.vo: Bålets flammer lokker de nysgerrige børn tættere på.
shots.da: Totalbillede bagfra i barnehøjde: de to børn går langsomt ad skovsporet mod et alt for stort bål nede i en lavning.
shots.key: Wide shot from behind at child height, thirty metres back on a muddy forest track. The two children walk slowly away from camera along the track towards a large bonfire burning in a shallow hollow between the beech trunks. Flames two metres high, far too big for garden waste. Rain streaks glow orange near the fire.
shots.move: The two children walk slowly and cautiously away from camera towards the fire. The camera follows at a distance and falls slightly behind.

shots.vo: Selvom regnen står ned i stænger, buldrer ilden lystigt.
shots.da: Nært på bålet: det brænder voldsomt, mens regnen vælter ned.
shots.key: Close shot of a big bonfire of branches burning fiercely in pouring rain, raindrops streaking through the firelight, steam and smoke rising, dark forest behind.
shots.move: Flames roar and sway, heavy rain pours through the firelight, steam rises. Very slow push-in.

shots.vo: Midt i bålet ligger en bylt.
shots.da: Over skulderen på børnene: i midten af bålet en mørk, indpakket bylt.
shots.key: Over-the-shoulder shot from behind the two children, their hooded heads soft and dark in the foreground left and right, the bonfire sharp between them. In the middle of the fire a dark wrapped bundle about seventy centimetres long lies across the burning branches; its shape is hard to read.
shots.move: The children stand completely still. Flames lick around the bundle. Rain falls. Slight handheld drift.

shots.da: Inde i bålet: bylten, pakket i et svedet tæppe og smeltet plastik, halvt skjult af flammer.
shots.key: Close-up inside the fire: a dark bundle wrapped in a scorched wool blanket and melted black plastic lies across burning branches, partly hidden by flames. The shape is ambiguous. Nothing inside it is visible.
shots.move: Slow push-in. Flames curl over the bundle, embers drift up, raindrops hiss on the logs.

shots.da: Lav vinkel bagfra: to små silhuetter foran det tårnhøje bål.
shots.key: Low angle from behind at ground level: the two small children stand side by side as dark silhouettes against the towering bonfire, rain streaks glowing orange around them.
shots.move: The children stand frozen; the younger leans slightly towards the older. Flames flicker. Handheld.

shots.da: Helt tæt: kanten af bylten i flammerne – forkullet uld, boblende plastik, gløder.
shots.key: Extreme close-up of the edge of the wrapped bundle in the flames: charred wool fabric, bubbling melted black plastic, glowing embers. Abstract, nothing recognisable inside.
shots.move: The fabric smoulders, the plastic bubbles, flames lick across. Very slow push-in.

shots.da: I jordhøjde: en lille rød gummistøvle træder baglæns gennem en vandpyt, der spejler ilden.
shots.key: Close shot at ground level: a small red rubber boot in a puddle that reflects the orange fire, rain rings spreading across the water, wet leaves.
shots.move: The boot steps slowly backwards out of the puddle, a light splash, rain rings keep spreading.

shots.da: Meget langt ude: bålet i den mørke skov, børnene små foran det. Det ene barn træder et skridt tilbage.
shots.key: Very wide shot from far back in the dark forest: the fire burning in the hollow, the two children tiny in front of it, rain and mist, the rest of the frame is darkness and trunks.
shots.move: Locked-off camera. Flames flicker, rain falls. The smaller child takes one step backwards.
